messages.text: I’ll read the new pipeline contract, get the reproducible high-statistics generator ready first, then add the combined audit and feature readback.

The generator is ready: it creates 10 training batches and two independent validation batches of 10,000 events, with distinct seeds and explicit campaign IDs. The readback will audit hits and accumulate features in one compiled pass, preserving the primary, identity, worker and input checks.

Completed `ECAL-HIGHSTAT-SOFTENG-PIPELINE` against `e9aabc83d3c8aa4127d1bcd824db0a134e69e7b0`.

- Generator prepares100k training +20k fresh validation as12 independent10k batches, with distinct seeds, campaign IDs, frozen geometry/library hashes and disk guards.
- Readback combines native primary/hit validation and feature accumulation in one ROOT pass. It preserves original audit checks and NPZ keys; reconstructed features use no truth inputs.
- Only the three assigned Python files changed.

All11 tests passed under ROOT6.40.04/EDM4hep. The retained24-event pilot passed in2.2s with13,118 cells; identities, counts, workers, primary errors and ROOT hash matched the old audit. Signals/features agreed within the tested roundoff tolerances. Updated lightweight guard tests also passed after rejecting equal seed pairs and nonfinite reserves.

Ready-to-run readback:

```sh
python3 -B software/analysis/calorimeter_digitization/highstat_readback.py \
  --run BATCH/run --sample BATCH/input --output BATCH/analysis
```

No transport launched or publication performed. Full10k readback throughput remains unmeasured. Final source hashes were sent separately for freezing.
